title: Clarify CLIA bundle taxonomy in the public profile
description: Make the public CLIA profile state the Command Line Interface Assistant name, the .digikoma.clia, .agent.clia, and .ghost.clia bundle kinds, and the current Pages documentation route.
acceptanceCriteria: The profile identifies CLIA as Command Line Interface Assistant.
The three CLIA bundle kinds are explained in operator-facing language.
The documentation link matches the Pages deployment route.
